generationInputs.prompt: A still life features a large, red, hand-shaped lollipop positioned diagonally on a coral-pink surface. The lollipop's "fingers" point towards the upper left, while its white stick extends to the lower right. White sans-serif text is printed on the lollipop, reading "HOY" stacked over "TE DAN POR," and then "DETROIT" in a larger font. Below "DETROIT" is the number "55" and a smaller line of illegible text. To the left of the hand lollipop is a light blue speech bubble with a white outline. Inside, dark teal cursive text reads "Tu suerte dice....". A round, clear and white candy rests in the upper right. In the lower right is a round lollipop with alternating radial stripes of white and purple. Each item casts a shadow to its right and slightly below on the coral-pink background, suggesting a light source from the upper left.
